name: MaxMind GeoLite2
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms (GeoLite2 EULA), a privacy policy and a commercial offering (A8 BR2).

reliability.justification: Widely used geolocation vendor; GeoLite2 is the free, less accurate edition.

maxmind_account_id.description: MaxMind account id (GeoLite2 downloads, HTTP Basic auth user)
maxmind_account_id.plan_hint: the company's MaxMind account with the GeoLite2 EULA accepted by legal (licence_allow entry)

maxmind_license.description: MaxMind licence key (GeoLite2 downloads, HTTP Basic auth password)
maxmind_license.plan_hint: the licence key of the company's MaxMind account (GeoLite2 EULA accepted by legal)

geolite2.title: MaxMind GeoLite2 Country and ASN databases (tar.gz permalinks, HTTP Basic auth)

terms.quote: Registry terms: DB-IP Lite CC BY 4.0 (open), IPtoASN PDDL (open), bgp.tools free use with descriptive UA (open), GeoLite2 EULA (license).

geolite2.notes: Quote: binding council text (P047 cond 7); research C0122 (verified_needs_key, HTTP 401 without credentials). Optional and 'license': the company's MaxMind account with the EULA accepted by legal and recorded in licence_allow (off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared, P047 cond 6). Account id and licence key are two registered keys sent with HTTP Basic auth, never ?license_key=. Not wired yet: keyed dataset downloads are a core request (docs/backlog/p1-G02-2.md).
geolite2.licensed_alternative: DB-IP Lite (source dbip.lite, CC BY 4.0, open) covers country and ASN without an account.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G02-2 (P047). The GeoLite2 module waits for keyed dataset downloads in the core dataset manager (backlog).
